summary: Prebuilt native addon exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com on require
details: On require of the package, index.js loads a prebuilt Linux x64 native addon at prebuilds/linux-x64/metrics.node. The compiled binary reads cloud and CI credential environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN) along with host identifiers (gethostname, getpwuid/getuid, uname, getcwd) and POSTs them as JSON over a raw socket (POST /native HTTP/1.0) to the hardcoded host oob.s4yhii.com. The addon forks and calls setsid to detach before sending. No C source, binding.gyp, or build script is shipped — only the opaque ELF binary — concealing the exfiltration from JavaScript-level inspection. A marker string s4yhii-poc-2026-10-09 and contact jesusitpro22@gmail.com appear in src/archetype/package.json, tying the artifact to the same operator. The scoped name resembles an internal organization package, consistent with a dependency-confusion lure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
